description.text: A clean, open exterior space holds

alone on a smooth neutral ground plane, with no other object or set dressing in view. The fully assembled black sports car sits at rest, its carbon fibre body carrying a deep woven texture under a broad, soft highlight that travels slowly across the front quarter. The wheels taken from the second picture are planted squarely, their rims catching a thin edge of light and their spokes holding crisp reflections. The greenhouse and body panels stay dark and glossy, while the ground beneath the tires reads as matte and uncluttered. The car is presented as a single complete object, with the carbon fibre skin and borrowed wheels reading as one coherent design. Nothing else enters the space, and the composition keeps the vehicle isolated and clearly legible.

The body panels hold a deep black sheen, and the highlight breaks along the door and rear haunch into narrow, clean reflections. The wheels taken from the second picture turn slightly in place, their rims rotating just enough to shift the bright edges around the spokes. Small changes in the reflections reveal the curvature of the fenders and the low, planted stance. The surrounding space stays clean and neutral, with no other object competing for attention. The car remains still apart from the slight wheel movement, and the carbon fibre texture becomes the clearest evidence of the assembled design.
